description: Native Device Storage Local Music Engine for on-device MP3/FLAC/M4A/WAV playback, MediaStore scanning, and Library integration in A1 Swaara v1.1.3

userStories.title: Android Storage Permissions Architecture
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to gracefully request permission to access my device's audio files so that my local library can be indexed safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add READ_MEDIA_AUDIO permission to AndroidManifest.xml for SDK >= 33
Add READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission with maxSdkVersion=32 for backward compatibility
Implement reactive runtime permission composable requesting media permissions
Gracefully handle permission rejection with an informative empty-state and settings launcher
Code compiles cleanly offline
userStories.notes: Target Android 13+ and backward compatibility verified

userStories.title: MediaStore Audio Scanner Engine
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to scan my device's music files and extract titles, artists, albums, durations, and album artwork.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SwaaraDeviceMusicScanner.kt using ContentResolver and MediaStore.Audio.Media
Filter out ringtones, alarms, notifications, and audio shorter than 10 seconds
Extract title, artist, album, duration, content URI, and album art URI
Expose scan results via Kotlin Coroutines Flow on Dispatchers.IO
Support manual rescan and refresh triggers
Typecheck and lint pass
userStories.notes: Fast asynchronous scanning connected through musicFilesAsFlow

userStories.title: PlayerService Local Playback Routing
userStories.description: As a user, I want tapping a local song to immediately start playback in the player with album art and seek bar support.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect local audio tracks in PlayerService by content URI scheme
Bypass YouTube and Piped extraction for local tracks and set MediaItem URI directly
Ensure lock screen controls, notification, and seek scrub bar function correctly
Support next, previous, shuffle, and repeat operations on local songs
Zero network requests dispatched during local song playback
userStories.notes: Direct ExoPlayer hardware sink playback via NewPipeAudioMediaSourceFactory isLocal check

userStories.title: Dedicated On-Device Tab in Library Screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated section in my Library to browse, sort, and search my on-device songs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add On-Device Files tab to Library screen navigation
Display song items with artwork thumbnails, duration, title, and artist
Provide sorting by title, artist, date added, and duration
Implement fast text filtering search bar
Add Play All and Shuffle All header actions
Typecheck and Compose lint pass
userStories.notes: Follows Swaara design system with gradient action buttons and Coil thumbnail loading

userStories.title: Offline Build and Release Verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify that the entire local music pipeline builds cleanly in offline mode and outputs a verified v1.1.3 APK.
acceptanceCriteria: ./gradlew.bat --offline assembleHttp3Release completes with zero errors
Output release APK generated in app/build/outputs/apk/http3/release/app-http3-release.apk
Version bumped to 1.1.3 (versionCode 14) in build.gradle.kts and version.json
Zero regressions in online streaming or podcast player
